messages:
Jun Park: Heads-up — we need a clear mapping from service error classes to fallback/degrade modes in the rollout policy UI. Ops keep getting surprised when 502 becomes 'soft-degrade' vs 'hard-switchover'.
Amanda Li: +1. Can we get a little matrix in console? Maybe hover to show criteria (latency threshold, error count, retryable?)
Sam Ortiz: The core ambiguity is 'transient error' vs 'saturation'. Telemetry doesn't always label them cleanly.
Jun Park: Yup. Suggestion: expose three signals in UI tooltip: error_type, 5m_error_rate, p99_latency. Show example traces from logs.
Marco: Also need operator override audit trail. If someone forces a hard switch, we must record operator id, reason, and snapshot of signals.
Amanda Li: Agreed. Proposal sketch:
```yaml
fallback_map:
  5xx_retryable:
    mode: soft_degrade
    trigger: error_rate > 0.05 && duration > 120s
  saturation:
    mode: hard_switchover
    trigger: cpu_p95 > 90% || queue_length > 1000
  model_mismatch:
    mode: graceful_rewrite
    trigger: quality_regression > 3% on evalset
```
Sam Ortiz: Nice. Two UI asks: 1) inline 'why was I routed?' explanation per request 2) link to the audit snapshot.
Jun Park: For (1) we can show a short reason string: `fallback=soft_degrade; cause=5xx_retryable; sample=ts=6180004325`
Amanda Li: How about retention? Audit logs can be noisy. We should keep full snapshot 30d, aggregated summaries 90d.
Marco: Operators want a 'replay' button to re-run sampled request through primary model in sandbox. Is that safe? data / PII concerns.
Sam Ortiz: Replay only on redacted payloads + customer opt-in. We'll add a checkbox.
ops-bot: deploy:policy-service v2.14 rolled to staging at 12:03 UTC :rocket:
Amanda Li: Quick UX mock: https://figma.com/proto/redwood/fallback-matrix (proof-of-concept) — shows matrix, operator override modal, and 'why routed' drawer.
Jun Park: Love it. Next steps: Product to write acceptance criteria, Eng to estimate for Q2 sprint. @Amanda Li can you own ACs? @Sam Ortiz can you scope telemetry changes?
Amanda Li: Yup, I'll draft ACs by EOD Friday.
Sam Ortiz: I'll scope telemetry + replay gating, ping infra for storage impact.
Marco: One more: we need backstop rule — if telemetry unavailable, default to conservative mode. Recommend default to safe variant (route to secondary model) rather than silent failover.
Jun Park: Default = 'fail closed to safe variant' — specify in docs. Ok thanks y'all :thumbsup:
